scope: Publicly documented model families and deployment contracts; not an exhaustive SKU or account-entitlement inventory. No model execution, downloads or benchmarks.

families.models: GPT-6 Astra; GPT-6.1 Sol; GPT-6 Sol/Luna; GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna; GPT-5.5/5.4 previous API generations
families.deployment: OpenAI API; Codex is a separate harness/account
families.capabilities: Text/code, vision, tools and reasoning vary by exact ID. GPT-6 reasoning with tools needs Responses.
families.limits: Use exact model page and account limits; context and maximum output are separate.
families.condition: GPT-6 now uses stateless Responses; older candidates retain Chat Completions. No live acceptance.

families.models: gpt-oss-20b; gpt-oss-120b
families.deployment: Local/server or managed hosting
families.capabilities: Text reasoning and tools; host must understand the model's Harmony format.
families.limits: Quantization and host configuration determine usable memory/context; not API GPT-6.
families.condition: Serve through an existing local HTTP adapter with correct template/parser. In-process llama_cpp is not a lean Chat endpoint.

families.models: claude-fable-5-1; claude-opus-5-5; claude-sonnet-5-5; claude-haiku-5-5
families.deployment: Claude API; supported cloud platforms have separate auth/IDs
families.capabilities: Text/image input, text output, tools and adaptive thinking; current effort control uses output_config.effort.
families.limits: Current overview lists 1M context and 128K output; entitlement/platform still matters.
families.condition: Native Messages and signed thinking blocks retained. Five effort levels now mapped for these four documented families. Thinking-off is not exposed as universal.

families.models: gemini-4-argon; Gemini 3.8 Flash/Live; 3.6 Flash; 3.5/3.1 Flash-Lite; 2.5 previous generation
families.deployment: Gemini Developer API; Vertex/managed Google uses different credentials
families.capabilities: Multimodal reasoning and tools; REST-compatible and Live transports differ. Audio/video model input is not automatically supported by Echo Chat.
families.limits: Catalog inputTokenLimit/outputTokenLimit now retained when supplied, never inferred from a family name.
families.condition: OpenAI-compatible REST and native Live adapters exist. Argon effort now recognized; thought signatures already survive tool results.

families.models: Gemma 4 E2B/E4B, 12B, 26B MoE, 31B; Gemma 3/3n previous families
families.deployment: Local GGUF/Transformers runtimes and hosted weights
families.capabilities: Gemma 4 supports thinking and image input; E2B/E4B/12B also have native audio capabilities. Runtime support must be checked separately.
families.limits: Effective small-model size is not the full multimodal allocation. Vision projector and KV cache add memory.
families.condition: Local native tools or bounded text recovery; Echo HTTP image support does not imply generic audio/video ingestion.

families.models: grok-4.7; 4.6/4.5; specialized 4.20 multi-agent
families.deployment: xAI API
families.capabilities: Reasoning, vision and function calling depend on model. Grok 4.7 effort is low/medium/high/xhigh; it cannot be disabled.
families.limits: Current catalog lists 500K context for Grok 4.7; use deployment-specific limits.
families.condition: Legacy Chat Completions remains; Grok Responses encrypted-state and native effort integration remain gaps. Multi-agent service is not Echo workers.

families.models: Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B; Muse Glimmer preceding family
families.deployment: Open weights; supported llama.cpp/vLLM/SGLang/other runtimes
families.capabilities: Multimodal, reasoning and agentic tools; ATEM format needs a matching parser.
families.limits: 816B total versus about 42B active; substantial server/unified memory even with low-bit quantization.
families.condition: HTTP shape alone is insufficient. Validate model format, image path and tools; no Muse-specific Echo adapter added.

families.models: Llama 4 Scout/Maverick; Llama 3.3 70B, 3.2 smaller/vision and 3.1 previous weights
families.deployment: Local/server and hosting partners
families.capabilities: Text/vision/tool behavior differs between instruct checkpoints and server templates.
families.limits: Scout 109B total/17B active and Maverick 402B/17B active are not desktop 17B dense allocations.
families.condition: Existing compatible HTTP runtimes; base checkpoints are not chat-ready agent models.

families.models: Qwen3.8-27B; Qwen3.8-Flash-Next; Qwen3.6/3.5 and Qwen3 smaller previous weights; hosted Qwen3.7-Max/Plus
families.deployment: Open weights; official Qwen cloud and other hosts have distinct IDs
families.capabilities: Current 3.8 is vision-language with flexible thinking; earlier dense/MoE/text/VL variants differ.
families.limits: Flash-Next card: 125B core plus 51B n-gram embeddings and 4B MTP; 262144 native context, extensible to 1M. Extension is not a default guarantee.
families.condition: Correct host parser/template required. Qwen3.8-27B card still labels its enhanced managed service coming soon; weights availability is separate.

families.models: Qwen3-Coder-Next; Qwen3-Coder and Qwen2.5-Coder previous weights
families.deployment: Local/server or hosted coding models
families.capabilities: Coder-Next targets long tool workflows and is explicitly non-thinking; other Qwen families must not define its controls.
families.limits: Coder-Next 80B total/3B active; 262144 native context. All required weights must fit or be offloaded.
families.condition: Removed false automatic thinking control for Coder-Next; tool execution still depends on host parser and Echo permissions.

families.models: deepseek-flash -> DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017; deepseek-v4-pro -> Pro-0813; earlier R1/V3 weights
families.deployment: DeepSeek API; local/server or hosted weights
families.capabilities: Thinking/tool modes and some vision vary by model. Tool cycles can require reasoning_content replay.
families.limits: Discovery exposes context_window, max_output_tokens, modalities, effort levels and per-protocol capabilities; Flash example is 1048576/393216.
families.condition: No DeepSeek cloud account adapter. Local reasoning_content replay is now opt-in and endpoint/model/account scoped; exact runtime requires acceptance.

families.models: Mistral Large 4; Medium 3.5; Small 4; Ministral 3 3B/8B/14B; older Large 3/Mixtral/Nemo
families.deployment: Mistral API and eligible open weights
families.capabilities: Multimodal/hybrid reasoning varies by generation; licenses differ, including modified MIT.
families.limits: Use exact card and host limits; do not equate an API alias with a local quant.
families.condition: Local HTTP hosting is conditional. Native Mistral authentication/ID/format adaptation is absent.

families.models: Codestral 25.08; historical Devstral Small 2/Medium; Magistral; Voxtral, OCR, embeddings and Timestral
families.deployment: Provider-specific code, speech, document, retrieval and forecast endpoints
families.capabilities: Fill-in-middle completion, transcription, OCR and embeddings are separate contracts; not every model is an agent chat endpoint.
families.limits: Catalog marks earlier Devstral/Magistral entries historical; historical does not prove every API deployment shut down.
families.condition: Do not add these to Chat based on name alone. Echo Creations/voice are separate capabilities.

families.models: Phi-4; Phi-4-mini; Phi-4-reasoning/plus; Phi-4-mini-flash-reasoning; Phi-4-multimodal
families.deployment: Local/server; Microsoft hosting depends on deployment
families.capabilities: Text, math reasoning and multimodal are distinct checkpoints. Mini-flash reasoning is a 3.8B hybrid math-focused model.
families.limits: Mini-flash reasoning card lists 64K context. A small reasoning model is not automatically a reliable full-tool agent.
families.condition: Exact hybrid architecture/runtime and tool support require owner validation; no blanket native-tools claim established.

families.models: GLM-5.3/5.3-Flash; GLM-5.2/5.1/5 and GLM-4.7/4.6/4.5 previous; GLM vision variants
families.deployment: Z.ai API, open weights and hosted partners
families.capabilities: Coding/reasoning/tools; thinking and effort rules change between generations. Vision must be established by the exact checkpoint.
families.limits: Use direct model metadata; do not transfer hosted GLM context/effort to a differently configured quant.
families.condition: No native Z.ai account adapter. Local GLM-5.3 no longer defaults to a thinking-off toggle; exact template and effort handling remain runtime-dependent.

families.models: Kimi K3.1 Pro/Highspeed (hosted); K3 open weights; earlier K2 variants
families.deployment: Official API; open weights and supported serving frameworks
families.capabilities: K3.1 Pro general API ID kimi-k3.1-pro differs from Coding Plan k3.1-pro; thinking-only, low/high/max, model-specific history and vision/tools.
families.limits: K3 card: 2.8T total/104B active, 1048576 context; server-cluster deployment.
families.condition: No native Kimi account adapter. General API and subscription Coding Plan are separate. Opt-in local reasoning replay does not imply K3.1 weights exist.

families.models: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash; M3; M2.7/M2.5 previous text models
families.deployment: Official API; open weights via supported runtimes
families.capabilities: M3 generation includes multimodal inputs and model-specific thinking controls; current API uses reasoning_content.
families.limits: M3 card lists about 428B total/23B active and 1M context; M3.1 has a different allocation.
families.condition: No native MiniMax provider. Local weights need the matching runtime and history contract; text parsing is not full multimodal support.

families.models: command-a-plus-05-2026; Command A/Reasoning/Vision and Command R7B previous variants
families.deployment: Cohere API and eligible weights/enterprise hosting
families.capabilities: A+ combines reasoning, image input and agents; Cohere Chat v2/tool/citation shapes are provider-specific.
families.limits: Catalog A+ 128K context/64K output; Command A has different limits. Command R March 2024 is deprecated.
families.condition: No Cohere-native route or citation adapter. Compatible local hosting is conditional, not direct API support.

families.models: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4 (released); Nemotron 3 Nano/Super/Ultra; 3.5 Super recipes
families.deployment: Open weights; NVIDIA NIM or supported runtimes
families.capabilities: Hybrid Mamba/attention MoE reasoning and agent tools; 3.5 Super recipe is vision-language. Training recipes alone do not prove a particular hosted SKU.
families.limits: 3 Nano 31.6B total; Super 120.6B; Ultra 550B. Up to 1M context needs runtime and memory support.
families.condition: Lightning card documents local and GPU deployment recipes; explicit chat-template thinking toggle now supported. No direct NIM account adapter or live validation.

families.models: Granite 4.1 3B/8B/30B instruct; 4.0 hybrid previous; separate Vision/Speech/Guardian/embedding
families.deployment: Open weights and watsonx deployment
families.capabilities: 4.1 language models focus on instruction and tool use; specialist variants serve different endpoints.
families.limits: Dense 3B/8B are consumer candidates after quantization; 30B needs larger memory.
families.condition: Local compatible HTTP with exact template; no watsonx-native auth route. Tool reliability is unmeasured.

families.models: SmolLM3-3B; smaller SmolLM2 previous
families.deployment: Local CPU/GPU/mobile and hosted compatible servers
families.capabilities: SmolLM3 thinking and XML or Python tool templates; Echo recognizes explicit XML tool-call JSON, not arbitrary executable Python.
families.limits: 3B weights are small; runtime KV cache and tool prompt still count.
families.condition: Select the XML/native parser contract. Python code examples must not become unrestricted execution.

families.models: Olmo-3-7B-Instruct; separate Think/Base checkpoints
families.deployment: Open weights and compatible local/server deployment
families.capabilities: Instruction and research-oriented weights; benchmark tool results do not guarantee the serving API's parser.
families.limits: 7B-class weight floor fits some consumer configurations; long context remains runtime-bound.
families.condition: Use instruction checkpoints and inspect actual tool format; no dedicated Olmo adapter.

families.models: AI21-Jamba2-3B/Mini; Jamba-Reasoning-3B; Jamba 1.7 previous
families.deployment: Open weights and AI21 hosting
families.capabilities: Hybrid/state-space architecture; base, instruct and reasoning formats differ.
families.limits: Small 3B and much larger Mini/MoE allocations need separate runtime checks.
families.condition: No AI21-native provider; small weights do not prove tool support on Echo's chosen runtime.

families.models: Step-3.7-Flash; Step-3.5-Flash previous
families.deployment: Open weights/server or provider hosting
families.capabilities: Multimodal MoE reasoning; vLLM documents step3p5 tool/reasoning parsers for both generations.
families.limits: Use checkpoint limits and compatible engine versions; not every GGUF engine has the architecture.
families.condition: No StepFun cloud adapter. Existing local HTTP path needs parser validation.

families.models: MiMo-V2.5; preceding MiMo variants
families.deployment: Official weights and supported serving frameworks
families.capabilities: Current card includes multimodal, coding and agent use; model-specific tool/reasoning encoding still matters.
families.limits: Use card configuration and runtime limits; no consumer-fit or throughput claim measured here.
families.condition: No MiMo-native API adapter; compatible local HTTP alone does not establish multi-step tool support.

families.models: rnj-1.5-instruct
families.deployment: Official open weights and supported local/server runtimes
families.capabilities: Additional instruction-model option discovered during the survey; exact tool/multimodal contract not established here.
families.limits: Read the specific card and engine support before selecting quantization/context.
families.condition: No model-specific integration claim; retain explicit unverified status instead of inferring native tools.

families.models: LFM2.5-24B-A2B; LFM2.5-8B-A1B; 2.6B/1.2B/350M/230M variants; separate VL/Audio
families.deployment: Author GGUF/FP8/ONNX/MLX and supported compatible runtimes
families.capabilities: Text tool agents; 24B is always-thinking. Python-list tool syntax requires a parser; sibling controls and modalities differ.
families.limits: 24B context 131072; 8B context 128000; total/active labels are rounded.
families.condition: Literal-only Liquid tool-call recovery added to existing policy gate. No blanket thinking controls or generic VL/audio route inferred.

families.models: Laguna-XS-2.1 (33B/3B); Laguna-S-2.1 (118B/8B); older XS.2/M.1
families.deployment: Open weights, Poolside API, hosted partners; pool ACP harness is separate
families.capabilities: Text coding, native tools, interleaved and preserved thinking; template kwargs for local thinking toggle.
families.limits: XS 262144 context; S up to 1M. Runtime memory follows total weights and context.
families.condition: Existing local HTTP plus opt-in scoped reasoning replay/template toggle. No native Poolside account adapter or imported pool execution policy.
